title: OmniTensor control reply version 1
description: One reply frame on the control socket, correlated to its request by id. Exactly one of result and error is present. An error here means the envelope failed — the frame did not validate, the method does not exist, the dispatch itself broke — while a method-level refusal (a quota, a rejected command) is a result, because the method answered and its answer is the refusal document.

version.description: Version of the envelope, not of any method's body.

id.description: The request's id, echoed verbatim; 0 when the request was too broken to carry one.

result.description: The method's reply document, exactly as its own wire schema defines it.

error.description: Why the envelope could not be answered.

code.description: Stable machine-readable cause a client can branch on.
